thread:
noah: RCA posted for Dedicated autoscaler config-format regression: https://docs.internal.redwood/postmortems/2150004321-autoscaler-format-regression

Summary: During a recent deploy the autoscaler accepted legacy string configs and new float configs but normalized only one path, which led to a small fraction of Dedicated pools being treated with an incorrect 'max_share' value -> temporary capacity shortfall and increased tail latency for some customers between 05:40-06:05 UTC. No PII exposure and no failed job completions.

ops-bot: Incident INC-215000 (https://incidents.redwood/INC-215000) resolved; follow-ups created.

tess: I will own the parsing normalization. Plan: add a schema coercion layer and strict validation, plus unit tests. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

irfan: I'll run the canary plan and check metrics. Canary: 1 prod pool, 5% traffic, 90m. If green, we roll.

mia: I'll prepare customer-facing language and coordinate with legal for SLA phrasing. Draft due in 4h.

noah: Owners: tess (code + tests), irfan (canary + metrics), mia (customer comms). Checkpoints: PR + tests by EOD tomorrow, prod canary next day 09:00 UTC, postmortem review in engineering sync. 30-day follow-ups: CI schema enforcement, config audit across Dedicated pools.

ops-bot: PR opened by tess -> https://git.internal.redwood/pulls/10055

tess: Ping eng-runtime & eng-qa for reviews. Adding backwards-compat tests for legacy configs.

irfan: Starting staging canary now, will report results in this thread.

mia: Draft posted in doc, tagging legal.

noah: Thanks all. Quick sync at 14:00 UTC to confirm rollout schedule. React with :raised_hand: if you can't make it.
